journey.name: EXC-01: 断网无连接异常场景
journey.description: 验证在网络断开或网关不可达时发起连接请求，应用能够捕获连接错误，给出明确的可读性失败提示（如网络未连接或域名解析失败），并提供重试入口，禁止发生白屏、未捕获异常或进程卡死。

actions.action: Verify that the "网关地址" input field is visible on screen
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "https://192.0.2.1:8443" into the "网关地址" field
Click the "用户名 / 账号" input field
Type "offline_user" into the "用户名 / 账号" field
Click the "访问凭据 / 密码" input field
Type "DummyPassword123" into the "访问凭据 / 密码" field
Verify that a readable error message indicating connection failure is displayed
Verify that the "重试" button is visible and clickable
Click the "重试" button to confirm state recovery
Verify that the login form remains editable and the app has not crashed
